tags.name: Kalipayan Wall
tags.qa_notes: 2026-08-17 RE-AUDIT — CORRECTION: Difficulty changed Beginner→Intermediate. Re-pulling tropicaldivers-alona.com's actual current page text shows it explicitly states the site is 'Suitable for intermediate divers,' not 'Beginner-Intermediate' as the prior 2026-06-25 note claimed — that prior citation did not match the source. Valm Divers lists it as general 'Recreational' (no explicit level). Corrected to Intermediate as the more accurate reading of the primary cited source, consistent with 30-32m depth and moderate current. Depth confirmed ~30m (Tropical Divers: 'Maximum 30 meters'; Alona Divers Club: 4-32m). Added note (single-source, Alona Divers Club, unconfirmed elsewhere): an old traditional Filipino boat reportedly rests at ~32m carrying scuba tanks — mentioned as an unconfirmed report, not asserted as fact. Marine life reconfirmed across three operators: batfish, lionfish, nudibranchs, ghost pipefish, dragon seamoth/pegasus fish, seahorses, soft corals. Stonefish still not confirmed by 3 sources — remains described as 'reported' only.

tags.name: Arco Point
tags.qa_notes: 2026-08-17 RE-AUDIT: Re-pulled all three sources. DEPTH CONFLICT found and now disclosed in markdown rather than stated as a single figure: SM Divers gives 8-9m entrance to 18m exit; Alona Divers Club (also a cited source) gives 5m entrance to 16m exit; Alona Divers (3rd cited source) gives an overall site range of 4-27m and frames the dive as a drift/wall dive (wall on right shoulder, current running south) rather than a simple shallow-to-deep swim-through. Kept SM Divers' figures as the primary narrative (most detailed, site-specific guide) but added a sentence noting sources differ by a few meters on the exact tunnel depths. Whale shark: Alona Divers Club (cited source) says whale sharks are 'potentially' seen — added as a single-source, unconfirmed, occasional-at-best mention rather than omitted entirely or stated as fact. Blue-ring octopus retained as 'occasionally reported' (Valm Divers). Marine life otherwise reconfirmed: frogfish (painted/warty), banded sea kraits, nudibranchs, morays, sweeper/cardinal fish.
